tonight.headline: Up 47.9 with Love and Denver still playing
body: Bad news first: Garrett Wilson (4.6 on three targets), Isaiah Likely (3.2 in McCarthy's first Giants start) and Jalen Coker on the bench (1.9) all had their worst games of the season. You still lead 88.96 to 41.02 and ESPN gives you 73%.

Every Chem starter is locked — Love and the Broncos D/ST are playing now. JuiceJam still have CeeDee Lamb and Dameon Pierce on Monday night and the Seahawks D/ST tonight, plus Jacobs and LaPorta in progress. There is nothing left to set this week.

case.label: The script that beats you
case.body: JuiceJam need roughly 48 more from Jacobs, LaPorta, the Seahawks D/ST, Lamb and Pierce while Love and Denver add little. Lamb projects 18.6 against a Philadelphia defence starting Tanner McKee's offence opposite (RotoWire DAL-PHI) — a big Lamb night plus a Jacobs touchdown is how it closes.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Nothing you can do: every starter has kicked off. A Love injury in the second half would only cost the points he has not yet scored.

doFirst.deadlineLabel: WHEN THE WEEK ROLLS — Tue, once Week 8 unlocks
doFirst.title: Allen back in at quarterback over Love
doFirst.subtitle: Love started only for Buffalo's Week 7 bye. ESPN carries this lineup into Week 8 unless you change it.

case.label: The move
case.body: Josh Allen (254.2 rest-of-season, ESPN) returns from the bye; Jordan Love (200.2) was added on 15 Oct for this one week. One quarterback starts in Chem.

case.label: The rest of Week 8
case.body: Likely (Giants) and Fairbairn (Texans) are on bye; Kamara (Saints) too. Tuten and Diggs return. Tuesday's run sets the RB/WR slots and the tight-end and kicker covers on Week 8 projections — Hockenson, Hunter Henry and Mayer are the tight-end shortlist.

case.label: Why a card now
case.body: Every Chem game this week has kicked off, so this is the only lineup move left and it cannot be made until the week rolls. Written now so it is not lost.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Love outscores Allen in Week 8 (archive) — graded on the outcome. Allen injured before Week 8 voids it.

worthALook.name: T.J. Hockenson

case.label: The player

case.body: On waivers until Wed 28 Oct 01:00 CDMX. Chem's priority resets weekly, so a claim costs nothing lasting; the natural drop is Love once Allen is back.

case.body: Tuesday, on Week 8 projections against Henry and Mayer. Changes if another free tight end projects more than two points above him.
